notes: Both לְ's are unrepresented under rule 40 because the ASV writes 'upholdeth all' and 'raiseth up all' with bare English objects.
The two articles are rendered differently by the ASV and each takes what is written for it under rule 41: 'that' alone in the first colon, 'those that' in the second, headed on the supplied pronoun.
'up' in 'raiseth up' is the phrasal particle of the English verb by which the ASV renders זָקַף and stays with the verb under rule 44; the head is unaffected.
